title: Governor spectral training
question: How do we move Gemma and Qwen out of the model and out of text context into spectral vectors, residual patterns, and VRAM shards the model is already fluent in — then reason by pointer-token?
not: SGD on the serving Gemma. Prompt stuffing. Stealing GPU 0 or 3.

governor.job: issue shards, gate fluency, reason by pointer

substrates.name: Spectral vectors
substrates.fluency: Slotting changes next-token distribution in ~260 µs. English recap is failure.

substrates.name: Residual patterns
substrates.fluency: Held-out case lights the same bands. Lesson prose does not.

substrates.name: VRAM shards
substrates.fluency: Emitting the pointer retrieves the page. Pasting the page is failure.

beat.do: Name what still lives in weights or text context.
Fan out compact 8k probes on GPU 2.
Classify each candidate: spectral | residual | vram-shard | reject.
accept | rework | reject with fluency fields, n≤8 on GPU 1.
Write the tensor / pointer map. Name retired context bytes.
Next turn dereferences. It does not restuff.
Held-out case: pointer works, prose recap does not.

reasoning.title: Classify
reasoning.do: fact | plan | proof | style | identity | unknown

reasoning.title: Point
reasoning.do: Emit pointer-token 128000–128512 and/or slot SPEC-XX. Do not paste shard text.

reasoning.title: Inject
reasoning.do: Vault: token → offset → KV page. Atomic. No CPU fallback in the decode loop.

reasoning.title: Residual
reasoning.do: Capture layers 12–24, project to Ψ_128, apply h' = h + γ(ΨΨᵀ)h if loaded.

reasoning.title: Delta
reasoning.do: Generate only what is not already in the retrieved pages.

reasoning.title: Fluency
reasoning.do: If the completion restates the shard in English, the shard failed. Rewind.

reasoning.title: Retire
reasoning.do: Name the context bytes this turn did not need.

invariants: Hive forage is only this question.
No SGD on GPU 1 while the Governor is serving.
Governor n≤8. Qwen volume stays on GPU 2.
Fluency receipt or it did not happen.
Text context is the waste product.
